info.name: ediFabric Native X12 API (Azure Functions)
info.description: The offline ediFabric Cloud v2 and v3 X12 operations of this example. Set baseUrl to where the API runs. serial is the demo serial, which has a small daily quota: replace it with yours.

request.description: X12 in, validation report with a 999 out (v2).
X12 in, JSON out. X-EdiFabric-Offset is 0.
X12 in, JSON then the validation report out. Split the body at the byte offset in X-EdiFabric-Offset.
X12 in, JSON then the validation report with the acknowledgment out. Split the body at the byte offset in X-EdiFabric-Offset.
v3 JSON in, X12 out. Include SE, GE and IEA with the correct counts.
